subject: Install and run shiny server on gentoo machine

messages.author: 666639abb29e043f
messages.subject: Install and run shiny server on gentoo machine
parts:
Hi ,

Installed shiny server on gentoo linux( Linux dcmodel6 4.6.1-gentoo #1 SMP Thu Jun 9 13:35:39 CDT 2016 x86_64 Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU E5-2690 v3 @ 2.60GHz GenuineIntel GNU/Linux) follow link (s://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/wiki/Building-Shiny-Server-from-Source). 

The /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf :
===============================

# Instruct Shiny Server to run applications as the user "shiny"

run_as shiny;


# Define a server that listens on port 3838

server {

  listen 3838;


  # Define a location at the base URL

  location / {


    # Host the directory of Shiny Apps stored in this directory

    site_dir /home/shiny/apps;


    # Log all Shiny output to files in this directory

    log_dir /var/log/shiny-server;


    # When a user visits the base URL rather than a particular application,

    # an index of the applications available in this directory will be shown.

    directory_index on;

  }

}


=============================================================




The /etc/init.d/shiny-server look like:

=============================================================

#!/sbin/openrc-run

prog=/usr/local/shiny-server/bin/shiny-server

lockfile=/var/run/shiny.pid


depend() {

    use net

 }


start() {

    ebegin "Starting Shiny Server Daemon"

    start-stop-daemon --start --quiet --background --user shiny -m --pidfile $lockfile --exec $prog 

    eend $?

  }


stop() {

     ebegin "Stopping Shiny daemon"

     start-stop-daemon --quiet --stop --pidfile $lockfile

     eend $?

    

  } 
=========================================================

the server starts ok, but the application failed at the initialization: 

-------------------------------

An error has occurred

The application failed to start.

The application exited during initialization.


----------------------------------------------------------------


The app can be run in the shiny account with "R -e "shiny::runApp" command line but not pick up by the shiny server, 


Help and suggestion are appreciated



Hai
